context_files_read.purpose: Repository controlling instructions and safety boundaries.
key_findings: Machine-readable artifacts are the product; reports are only views.
Fake-only evidence must never be presented as real Valkey evidence.
P14 1000-node behavior is opt-in dry-run only and must not be automatic.

context_files_read.purpose: Automatic phase loop and P14 boundary.
key_findings: Automatic work stops at P13; P14 requires explicit opt-in environment.
Missing data must remain explicit and artifacts remain source of truth.
harness_architect must design tests, schemas, CLI gates, artifact validators, and real/fake boundaries.
Output path and JSON fields are fixed by the loop-engineering protocol.
L03 must add metric catalog and coverage matrix schemas, a builder script, tests, and generated JSON artifacts.
Coverage matrix must layer fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run.
1000 dry-run must never count as real coverage.
Metric coverage validation command is python3 scripts/build_metric_coverage_matrix.py --out-dir artifacts/loop_engineering/reports.
Metric coverage tests must run with python3 -m pytest -q tests/metrics tests/coverage.
P14 and real/fault wrappers are separate validation sections and should not be run for this harness design.

context_files_read.purpose: Prepared L03 scope, constraints, and known risks.
key_findings: Required outputs are metric_catalog.json and coverage_matrix.json under artifacts/loop_engineering/reports.
Historical artifacts must not be mutated to improve coverage.
The main risk is overstating P14 dry-run planner evidence as real coverage.
Allowed verdicts are APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, and BLOCKED.
No additional top-level properties are allowed.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing artifact schema conventions and metric-bearing artifact shapes.
key_findings: metric_sample JSONL contains timestamp, source, phase_id, run_id, and nested metrics.
valkey_e2e_evidence declares real_valkey, nodes_observed, probe_result, data_path_result, and Valkey versions.
Report schemas generally require schema_version, artifact_type, phase_id, run_id, created_at, producer, and status.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing artifact audit behavior and P14 boundary implementation.
key_findings: P14 is explicitly optional and dry-run-only in committed artifact audit.
Historical manifest drift may be nonblocking only through explicit allowlists.
Artifact validation reads JSON/JSONL and schemas, not rendered report views.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing artifact-first graph builder and report-view policy.

dry_run_only and real_valkey_coverage are already computed per node.
P09/P11/P12/P13 provenance edges identify the same source artifacts L03 should consume.
CI tests assert workflow commands are present and forbid P14 opt-in or real/fault wrapper execution in static gates.
New metric coverage CI guard should follow the audit/provenance pattern.
Current graph status is PASS with zero blocking findings.
P14 boundary records real_valkey_coverage=false and no dry-run artifacts from L02.
Nodes include real_valkey_coverage and dry_run_only metadata that L03 can cross-check.
The plan has node_count=1000 but runtime.dry_run=true and constraints.no_execution=true.

Artifact records real_valkey=true, nodes_observed=6, probe_result=PASS, data_path_result=PASS, and Valkey 9.1.0.

findings.description: L03 required harness assets are not yet implemented: metric catalog schema, coverage matrix schema, builder, generated artifacts, and tests are absent.
evidence: tests/metrics and tests/coverage do not exist

findings.description: The harness must prevent 1000 dry-run planning artifacts from satisfying real coverage requirements.
evidence: AGENTS.md and CODEX_START_HERE.md require P14 opt-in and dry-run-only treatment

findings.description: Metric values live in heterogeneous JSON and JSONL structures, so the builder needs deterministic extractors rather than a single generic numeric scan.
Rendered report artifacts exist and must not become metric sources of truth.

proposed_harness.name: metric_catalog_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add schemas/artifact/metric_catalog.schema.json requiring schema_version=v1, artifact_type=metric_catalog, created_at, producer, status, summary, metrics, findings, and every metric entry to include name, unit, source_artifact, source_sha256, phase_id, scenario, node_count_scope, evidence_layer, real_valkey_coverage, dry_run_only, missing_semantics, value_status, source_pointer, and source_artifact_type.

proposed_harness.name: coverage_matrix_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add schemas/artifact/coverage_matrix.schema.json requiring schema_version=v1, artifact_type=coverage_matrix, layers exactly covering fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run, surfaces for cluster_build, management, workload, observability, fault, failover, stability, cleanup, scale, report_visualization, summary counts, p14_boundary, entries, and findings.

proposed_harness.name: metric_coverage_builder_cli
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add scripts/build_metric_coverage_matrix.py with --out-dir and optional --root arguments; it must read only machine-readable JSON/JSONL artifacts and codex/phase_manifest.json, emit metric_catalog.json and coverage_matrix.json, validate both outputs against their schemas, return nonzero on blocking findings, and never invoke P14, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, or fault_failover_gate.py.

proposed_harness.name: metric_catalog_current_repo_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add tests/metrics covering current repository extraction: catalog includes metrics from cluster build real evidence, management operation durations, workload QPS and latency, observability metric_sample JSONL, fault safety checks, failover latency and missing split-brain metric, stability summaries and JSONL samples, cleanup counts, scale rung metrics, and analysis/report provenance without using rendered CSV/HTML/SVG as sources.

proposed_harness.name: coverage_matrix_layer_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add tests/coverage asserting all required layers are present; small-real maps to real 6-node phases P03-P11, 30 maps to P12 valkey_e2e_evidence_30.json, 50 and 100 map to P13 evidence, fake maps only to P00-P02 non-real planner/config evidence, and 1000-dry-run maps only to dry-run planning or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON entries with real_valkey_coverage=false.

proposed_harness.name: dry_run_real_coverage_negative_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add fixture tests that inject a 1000-node dry-run plan and assert it cannot satisfy any layer requiring real coverage; if a dry-run artifact has node_count=1000, runtime.dry_run=true, constraints.no_execution=true, or path contains 1000_dryrun, the matrix entry must be evidence_kind=dry_run and real_valkey_coverage=false.

proposed_harness.name: missing_metric_semantics_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add tests that require missing metrics to be represented as value_status=MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with a non-empty reason, and reject null numeric values without explicit missing_semantics.

proposed_harness.name: real_evidence_cross_check_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add static artifact tests, not wrapper execution, that require real coverage entries to point at valkey_e2e_evidence artifacts with real_valkey=true, status=PASS, probe_result=PASS, data_path_result=PASS where expected, Valkey version prefix 9.1., and nodes_observed matching the declared layer node count for 30, 50, and 100.

proposed_harness.name: ci_metric_coverage_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: Update .github/workflows/github-coverage-gates.yml and add tests/ci/test_metric_coverage_gate.py so CI runs the builder, schema-validates metric_catalog.json and coverage_matrix.json, runs tests/metrics tests/coverage, and continues to forbid P14 opt-in environment variables and real/fault wrapper commands in the static coverage job.

proposed_harness.name: artifact_report_checks
proposed_harness.acceptance: Generated artifacts must have status=PASS only when schemas validate, every required surface has at least one explicit PASS, MISSING, or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON entry, source_artifact paths exist with SHA256 recorded, and blocking_findings_count is zero.

implementation_plan.rationale: The schema should make each metric traceable to an artifact and source pointer, distinguish numeric/string/boolean/status metrics, require unit and missing semantics, and allow explicit MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON without fabricated values.
The schema should force the evidence layers fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run, require surface rows, and encode p14_boundary so dry-run evidence cannot be promoted to real coverage.

implementation_plan.step: Implement the builder with deterministic extractors.
implementation_plan.rationale: Use codex/phase_manifest.json plus committed JSON/JSONL artifacts under artifacts/phases and artifacts/loop_engineering/reports. Extract known metric families with explicit source pointers, SHA256s, scenarios, node_count_scope, layer, evidence_kind, real_valkey_coverage, and dry_run_only. Do not parse rendered report views as metric sources.

implementation_plan.step: Classify evidence layers and surfaces centrally.
implementation_plan.rationale: Layering should be data-driven and auditable: P00-P02 non-execution evidence is fake, P03-P11 real wrapper evidence is small-real, P12 30-node evidence is 30, P13 50 and 100 evidence are 50 and 100, and 1000-dry-run is dry-run only or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON when P14 artifacts are absent.

Tests should fail before implementation and then prove that catalog entries exist for all required surfaces and that every entry has name, unit, source artifact, scenario, node_count_scope, and missing semantics.

implementation_plan.step: Add coverage matrix and dry-run boundary tests.
implementation_plan.rationale: Tests should verify layer completeness, real evidence cross-checking, dry-run isolation, report-view exclusion, and explicit missing/skipped semantics.

implementation_plan.step: Add CI guard tests and workflow commands.
implementation_plan.rationale: CI must run the static metric coverage builder and tests while preserving the existing no-P14/no-real-wrapper policy for the fast coverage workflow.

implementation_plan.step: Generate and schema-validate L03 report artifacts.
implementation_plan.rationale: The stage output is the machine-readable catalog and matrix. HTML, CSV, or Markdown may be derived later, but L03 acceptance depends on these JSON artifacts.

acceptance_criteria: python3 scripts/build_metric_coverage_matrix.py --out-dir artifacts/loop_engineering/reports exits 0 and writes metric_catalog.json and coverage_matrix.json.

Metric catalog entries all include name, unit, source_artifact, source_sha256, scenario, node_count_scope, evidence_layer, real_valkey_coverage, dry_run_only, missing_semantics, value_status, and source_pointer.

Coverage matrix contains the required layers fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run and required surfaces cluster_build, management, workload, observability, fault, failover, stability, cleanup, scale, and report_visualization.
The 30, 50, and 100 real coverage entries point to valkey_e2e_evidence artifacts with real_valkey=true, status=PASS, Valkey version prefix 9.1., and nodes_observed matching the layer.
The 1000-dry-run layer has real_valkey_coverage=false for every entry and cannot satisfy any real coverage count.
Missing metrics are represented only as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with a non-empty reason; null values without missing semantics fail tests.
Rendered CSV, HTML, Markdown, and SVG reports are allowed as views or targets but never as source-of-truth metric inputs.
The GitHub coverage workflow runs the builder, schema validations, and tests/metrics tests/coverage, while continuing to forbid P14 opt-in and real/fault wrapper commands.
risks: A generic recursive numeric scan could catalog incidental fields or report-rendered values without semantic units.
P02 or P14 1000 dry-run planning artifacts could be incorrectly counted as real scale evidence if classification relies only on node_count.
String counters from docker stats can be unit-ambiguous; the catalog must encode them as raw/string metrics or parse into explicit units only when deterministic.
Historical artifacts may omit optional metadata; the builder must record MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON rather than invent phase, scenario, or unit details.
Workflow additions could accidentally run real Valkey wrappers in CI, increasing cost and violating the static L03 harness design.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run P14 or set VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN for L03 harness validation.
Do not run scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, or scripts/fault_failover_gate.py for L03 metric coverage validation.
Do not count any dry-run artifact as real Valkey coverage.
Do not parse CSV, HTML, Markdown, or SVG reports as source-of-truth metric inputs.
Do not mutate historical artifacts under artifacts/phases or artifacts/gates to improve coverage.
Do not fabricate units, metric values, scenarios, node counts, or missing data.
Do not weaken existing schemas, gate locks, audit scripts, provenance scripts, or CI guards.
notes: Harness design is approved for implementation. Expected initial failures are the absent schemas, builder script, tests/metrics, tests/coverage, CI guard, and generated JSON artifacts. L03 validation is static artifact analysis only; P14, real Valkey wrappers, and fault wrappers must remain out of this stage.
